picture.data: 小字：分出去叫 fan-out，收回來叫 fan-in

claims.headline: research:一個來源的工作，分給多個執行者同時做

picture.what: Title insert, the film's first frame of meaning. One task tile sits alone; it splits into 20 tiles riding 20 thin lines that swing open like a hand fan opening, ribs spreading from one pivot. The name fan-out (solid ink, a normal headline size, never an outline or giant background word) lands with the opening and the plain sentence with it; a small line says folding back is fan-in. The fan is a picture of the name, not a claim about where the word comes from. Then the ribs straighten into the 20 lanes of the stage, each carrying its tile (the insert hands over to the main axis, no cut).
motion_intent: one tile splitting into 20 ribs that swing open like a fan: this is what fan-out looks like
ribs straightening into lanes: the analogy hands over to the real stage

keys.what: the open fan, the name fan-out and the plain sentence readable at once; the fan-in line readable as small text

picture.headline: 一次全部分出去：20 個子代理
picture.data: 回來的結果 0 / 20；小字（獨立一行，3.0 s 起出現）：Claude Code 預設同時 20 個子代理，可調。來源：Claude Code 文件〈Create custom subagents〉code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents（查證 2026-10-19）

claims.headline: research:寬幅 fan-out 可在所有 worker 還在半途時把預算燒光
claims.data: research:Claude Code 預設同時 20 個子代理在跑時再生一個會失敗

picture.what: Seam in: the fan's ribs are now the 20 lanes and 20 task tiles drop into them at once (fan-out with no limit). Each lane's progress bar starts filling; a single budget bar labelled 用量額度 (usage limit) drains while they run. The budget hits zero while every bar is only about 35% full: all 20 bars freeze and go grey. The result tray stays empty; its counter reads 0 / 20. The small source stamp enters at about 1.5 s on its own line (on screen at least 4.0 s), separate from the budget scene, so the default is not read as the cause of the burn. This is a real scene the viewer may meet (spawning many subagents or requests at once), framed as 'you might have seen this', never as an official limit or as the author's private rule.
motion_intent: 20 tiles dropping at once: everything was sent at the same moment (fan-out)
budget bar draining while bars fill: cost is paid while work runs, not when results return
bars freezing grey at about 35%: the work stopped before anything finished
empty tray, counter 0 / 20: nothing came back

keys.what: all 20 lanes are running at once and the budget bar is visibly draining

headline, 20 frozen grey bars, the 用完 mark and the counter 0 / 20 readable at once; the source stamp (document title + address + check date) readable as small text; the frozen frame holds still (the freeze is the message)

picture.data: 下游一次只吃得下這麼多；超過的拿到 HTTP 429（請求太多）

picture.what: Seam in: the 20 grey bars fade out over about 0.4 s while queue, tray and ground stay; no cut. Same stage, reset. Headline asks the viewer's own belief as a question. Then a limit line appears across the lanes: the downstream limit (an API, a database). Lanes are added one by one (1, 2, 4, 8 ...); up to the limit each new lane speeds the tray up; past it, extra tiles hit the line and bounce back stamped 429, and the throughput bar (no digits) stops rising. The question is answered on screen: no, past the limit more workers only adds rejects.
motion_intent: lanes added one by one: the viewer's belief being tried
tiles bouncing off the limit line with a 429 stamp: the downstream refuses the excess
throughput bar rising then flat (no digits): speed saturates at the limit

limit line, at least two bounced tiles with a readable 429 stamp, the flat throughput bar and the data sentence

picture.data: 3 個 worker、5 個各 1 秒的工作 → 約 2 秒做完（逐一做要 5 秒）；名稱：worker pool／bounded concurrency

claims.headline: research:長駐、固定大小的一組 worker，從共用的佇列取工作
claims.data: research:3 個 worker、5 個各 1 秒的工作，程式約 2 秒完成

picture.what: Seam in: the lane collapse itself is the transition (no cut). The 20 lanes collapse to 3 fixed slots (the pool). 5 tiles wait in the queue. A free slot pulls the next tile; when a tile finishes, its result drops into the tray in the accent colour and the slot pulls again. A clock runs and stops at about 2 s; next to it a ghost row of the same 5 tiles laid end to end reads 5 s. Labels name the real terms once: worker pool, bounded concurrency. Source line: Go by Example, Worker Pools.
motion_intent: lanes collapsing to 3 slots: the fix is a fixed number of places
slot pulling the next tile only when free: work is taken, not pushed
result dropping into the tray in the accent colour: a result came back
clock stopping at about 2 s next to the 5 s ghost row: the pool still wins over one by one

keys.what: headline and the 3 slots with the label worker pool readable
one slot is empty for an instant and is pulling the next tile from the queue
the clock stopped at about 2 s next to the 5 s ghost row, both numbers and the source line readable

picture.headline: 收回來的時間，看最慢的那一個
picture.data: 每次同時問 100 台，約 63% 的機會至少要等一台慢的（1 台有 1% 的機率慢；1 − 0.99^100）；名稱 fan-in、tail latency 在慢工作那一拍出現；類比一句：扇子要等最後一根收回來，才合得起來

claims.data: research:同時問 100 台時約 63% 的使用者請求超過 1 秒

picture.what: Results now flow from the slots into the tray (fan-in). All tiles land fast except one that crawls; a bracket spans the waiting gap. Analogy beat (insert, about 1.5 s): the hand fan from the opening returns small, together with the tray, every rib folded except one still out; a short line says a fan only closes when the last rib comes in; then the fan leaves and the stage carries on. Then the stage zooms out to a grid of 100 small lanes, 1 in 100 tinted slow; a counter turns the arithmetic 1 − 0.99^100 into about 63%. Source line: Dean & Barroso, The Tail at Scale (2013).
motion_intent: one tile crawling while others have landed: the slowest decides when everything is back
bracket stretching over the wait: the cost of waiting made visible
fan folding with one rib still out: fan-in waits for the last one (analogy, subordinate)
zoom out to 100 lanes with one slow in each hundred: wider fan-out makes hitting a slow one likely
counter running to 63%: the arithmetic, not an estimate

camera.move: zoom out from the tray to the 100-lane grid at about 4.0 s

keys.what: headline, the names fan-in / tail latency, the slow tile with its wait bracket and the half-folded fan with its line readable
the 100-lane grid, the formula and the 63% number with its source line readable

picture.headline: 你的程式裡，上限就在這一行
picture.data: Python ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4)／asyncio.Semaphore(4)；Go g.SetLimit(4)；判斷：N 跟著下游上限走，不跟著工作數走；下游上限：看 API 文件的 rate limit，或 429 回應的 Retry-After；第一步：先設小，結果收得回來再往上加；驗收：429 變少、排隊不會一直變長

claims.data: research:Go `errgroup` 的 `Group.Go` 在達到上限時會阻塞到有空位

picture.what: Hands-on section, four parts in order, each its own readable beat. (1) Where: code close-up insert, the stage dims far enough that no lane or tray line crosses the code; three real code lines appear one after another, the limit number in each set in ink, bold and underlined, each line's language/API tag on its own small line, code in a monospace size that keeps the longest line (ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4), 33 chars) clear of both gutters; no default values shown. Sources: research §6 items 1, 6, 7. (2) Judgement: the limit line from F1 returns; the slot count is set by that line, not by the length of the queue; one short line says where to find that limit (the API's rate-limit docs, or Retry-After on a 429). (3) First step: the slot count starts small and grows by one only while the tray keeps filling. (4) Check: two small gauges, 429 count falling and queue length staying flat, labelled as what to watch. No invented API, no version-volatile number on screen.
motion_intent: code lines appearing one by one with the limit number lit: here is the line in your own code
limit line returning over the slots: the number comes from downstream
slot count growing by one while the tray fills: start small, raise it on evidence
two gauges settling: how you know it worked

keys.what: headline and all three code lines with the lit limit numbers readable
judgement sentence readable with the limit line and the slots
first-step sentence readable while the slot count is mid-growth and the tray still filling
the two gauges and their labels readable
